#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const int MAXN = 7;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const ll E100 = 570000004;
int n;
int g[MAXN][MAXN];
ll nxt[1<<MAXN][1<<MAXN];
int bitcnt[1<<MAXN];
vector<int> S[MAXN+1];
int id[1<<MAXN];
unordered_map<ll, int> dp[MAXN];

int solve(int i, ll msk) {
    if (msk == 0) return 0;
    if (i == n) return 1;
    auto it = dp[i].find(msk);
    if (it != dp[i].end()) return it->second;
    ll ret = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < (1<<n); ++s) {
        ll p = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (s & (1 << j)) 
                p = (p * g[i][j]) % MOD;
            else 
                p = (p * ((1 - g[i][j] + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
        }
        ll nmsk = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < 35; ++j) 
            if ((1LL << j) & msk) 
                nmsk |= nxt[s][S[i][j]];
        ret = (ret + p * solve(i+1, nmsk)) % MOD;
    }
    return dp[i][msk] = (int)(ret % MOD);
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d", &n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) 
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) { 
            int x;
            scanf("%d", &x);
            g[i][j] = (int)((ll)x * E100 % MOD);
        }
    for (int i = 1; i < (1<<n); ++i) 
        bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i & (i - 1)] + 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < (1<<n); ++i) {
        id[i] = S[bitcnt[i]].size();
        S[bitcnt[i]].push_back(i);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < (1<<n); ++i) 
        for (int j = 0; j < (1<<n); ++j) 
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) 
                if ((i & (1<<k)) && !(j & (1<<k)))
                    nxt[i][j] |= 1LL << id[j|1<<k];
    int ans = solve(0, 1);
    ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
    printf("%d\n", ans);
}
